text:
Merger Consideration per Company Common Share consists of 0.232 Parent Common Shares and $2.43 in cash (plus cash in lieu of fractional Parent Shares). Converted Company Restricted Stock is automatically converted into cash equal to Cash Consideration times the number of converted shares and a Parent Restricted Stock Award equal to Stock Consideration times the converted shares; Dissenting Shares receive no Merger Consideration.
Stock Consideration: 0.232 Parent Common Shares per Company Common Share; Cash Consideration: $2.43 in cash per Company Common Share; Fractional Share Consideration: cash in lieu of fractional shares (as applicable) per 2.7; Converted Company Restricted Stock: cash payment equal to the product of the number of Converted Company Restricted Stock and Cash Consideration, and a Parent Restricted Stock Award for a number of Parent Common Shares equal to the product of the number of Converted Company Restricted Stock and Stock Consideration (rounded to the nearest whole share, 0.5 down); Company PSU Awards: vest and be issued as Company Common Shares and converted into the Merger Consideration (Stock and Cash) under Section 2.1(a)(i). CVRs: not disclosed in the excerpt.
0.232 Parent Common Shares per Company Common Share; plus $2.43 in cash (the Stock Consideration and Cash Consideration), i.e., each Company Common Share is converted into the right to receive 0.232 Parent Common Shares and $2.43 in cash.
